title.en: Start here: the exam and the map of the subject
title.zh: 从这里开始：考试与整门课的地图

description.en: What the exam asks and how to spend your time, the three ingredients of machine learning, every model placed on four axes, and how the course is laid out.
description.zh: 考试怎么考、时间怎么分，机器学习的三个要素，每个模型在四条轴上的位置，以及这门课怎么排。

name.en: The model map: four axes, every model placed
name.zh: 模型地图：四条轴，每个模型的位置

description.en: Believing every formula is printed beside the question (probability rules are not)
description.zh: 以为所有公式都会印在题旁（概率公式不会）

description.en: Thinking naive Bayes has a non-linear boundary because it multiplies probabilities
description.zh: 因为朴素贝叶斯要把概率相乘，就以为它的边界是非线性的

text.en: You know the methods; the exam asks for them in a particular way. Lecture 23 gives the format: **2 hours plus 15 minutes of reading time**, closed book, pen and paper, any **non-programmable calculator**. It is **100 marks, 50% of your grade**, you attempt every question, and the questions carry different weights.
text.zh: 方法你已经学过，考试有它自己的问法。第 23 讲给出的形式：**2 小时，外加 15 分钟阅读时间**，闭卷，纸笔作答，可以带**不可编程的计算器**。**满分 100，占总成绩 50%**，每题都要做，各题分值不同。

rows.en: Explain or compare ideas of the subject; sometimes a small calculation
rows.zh: 解释或比较概念；有时带一点小计算

rows.en: Like the workshops: run a method on a small example
rows.zh: 像 workshop：在小例子上把方法算一遍

rows.en: show the working; sometimes describe the logic in words
rows.zh: 写出计算过程；偶尔用文字描述思路

rows.en: Like the assignments: choose and justify methods for a described problem
rows.zh: 像作业：为一个描述出来的问题选方法并说明理由

rows.en: one third of a page or more; attempt last
rows.zh: 至少三分之一页；留到最后做

text.en: The time works out to about 1.2 minutes per mark (120 minutes for 100 marks), so a 4-mark short answer deserves about 5 minutes and a Section C answer worth 15 marks about 18. Do not spend 10 minutes on a 3-mark calculation.
text.zh: 时间算下来大约每分 1.2 分钟（100 分 120 分钟）：4 分的简答配 5 分钟左右，15 分的 C 题配 18 分钟左右。别在一道 3 分的计算上花 10 分钟。

title.en: What is printed, what you must know
title.zh: 题旁印什么，你得自己会什么

text.en: The formula a question needs is **printed beside it**, with one exception: **probability**. So you will not be given Bayes' rule, the definition of conditional probability, the chain rule or the rule for independence. They are the few things to memorise exactly.
text.zh: 一道题要用的公式会**印在题旁**，唯一的例外是**概率**：贝叶斯公式、条件概率的定义、链式法则、独立性的写法，都不会给你。这是少数必须背熟的东西。

blocks.tex: P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(A, B)}{P(B)}, \qquad P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(B \mid A)\,P(A)}{P(B)}, \qquad P(A, B) = P(A)P(B) \;\; (A \perp B)

text.en: What is tested is then **understanding a formula** (what each term does, what changes if you change it) and **using it** (plugging in numbers correctly). A printed formula does not say which one to use, so knowing the methods still matters.
text.zh: 考的是两件事：**读懂公式**（每一项起什么作用，改动它会怎样）和**用它**（把数代对）。印出来的公式不会告诉你该用哪一个，所以方法本身还是要懂。

prompt.en: Which of these will you have to write from memory?
prompt.zh: 下面哪个需要你凭记忆写出来？

feedback.en: It is a formula of the subject, so it is printed next to the question.
feedback.zh: 这是本课的公式，会印在题旁。

feedback.en: Also printed: only probability formulas are withheld.
feedback.zh: 同样会印出来：只有概率公式不给。

label.zh: 贝叶斯公式 $P(A \mid B) = P(B \mid A)P(A)/P(B)$

feedback.en: Printed beside the question, like every non-probability formula.
feedback.zh: 和所有非概率公式一样，印在题旁。

explain.en: Probability is the one exception the lecture names. Naive Bayes, smoothing and entropy all rest on it, so these rules are worth knowing cold.
explain.zh: 第 23 讲点名的唯一例外就是概率。朴素贝叶斯、平滑、熵都建在它上面，这几条要背熟。

items.en: **Practise logs on your calculator.** Entropy and information gain use $\log_2$; know how to get it ($\log_2 x = \ln x/\ln 2$).
items.zh: **在计算器上练对数。** 熵和信息增益用 $\log_2$；要知道怎么按出来（$\log_2 x = \ln x/\ln 2$）。

items.en: **Do not get stuck in a calculation.** Leave the arithmetic, keep the setup: marks go to method.
items.zh: **不要卡在计算里。** 算不下去就留着，把式子列对：分数给方法。

items.en: **Do not write irrelevant things.** No points for effort; a wrong extra sentence can cost you.
items.zh: **别写无关的东西。** 不按努力给分；多写一句错的反而可能扣分。

items.en: **Memorise concepts, test yourself often.** Section A is won by short, exact explanations.
items.zh: **概念要记牢，常常自测。** A 部分靠短而准的解释拿分。

text.en: Lecture 23 sums the subject up as three ingredients. Every method you meet is a particular choice for each.
text.zh: 第 23 讲把整门课归成三个要素。每个方法都是对这三样的一种具体选择。

rows.en: discrete vs continuous · big vs small · labelled vs unlabelled · public vs sensitive
rows.zh: 离散 vs 连续 · 大数据 vs 小数据 · 有标签 vs 无标签 · 公开 vs 敏感

rows.en: A function from inputs to outputs whose parameters are unknown
rows.zh: 从输入到输出的函数，参数未知

rows.en: probabilistic vs geometric · discriminative vs generative · linear vs non-linear · parametric vs non-parametric
rows.zh: 概率型 vs 几何型 · 判别式 vs 生成式 · 线性 vs 非线性 · 参数式 vs 非参数式

rows.en: Finding the best parameters for a given task
rows.zh: 为给定任务找到最好的参数

rows.en: supervised · unsupervised · semi-supervised and active · self-supervised
rows.zh: 监督 · 无监督 · 半监督与主动学习 · 自监督

text.en: The rest of this page is about the middle row: the four model distinctions are the most examinable part of the map, and the one place where a wrong answer is easy to give.
text.zh: 后面几页讲中间那一行：模型的四组区分最容易考，也最容易答错。

alt.en: The four axes of the model map with the models on each side: probabilistic (NB, LR) against geometric (k-NN, SVM, perceptron); discriminative (LR, SVM, trees, MLP) against generative (NB); linear (NB, LR, perceptron, linear SVM) against non-linear (k-NN, trees, MLP, kernel SVM); parametric (NB, LR, MLP) against non-parametric (k-NN, trees, SVM).
alt.zh: 模型地图的四条轴及各自两侧的模型：概率型（NB、LR）对几何型（k-NN、SVM、感知机）；判别式（LR、SVM、决策树、MLP）对生成式（NB）；线性（NB、LR、感知机、线性 SVM）对非线性（k-NN、决策树、MLP、核 SVM）；参数式（NB、LR、MLP）对非参数式（k-NN、决策树、SVM）。

text.en: This is lecture 23's classification, exactly. Each axis asks one question of a model: how it reasons (**how likely** or **where in space**), what it learns (**P(y | x)** or **P(x, y)**), what shape its boundary has, and whether its size is fixed before it sees the data.
text.zh: 这就是第 23 讲的分类，原样照录。每条轴问模型一个问题：它怎么推理（**有多大可能**还是**在空间的哪里**），它学什么（**P(y | x)** 还是 **P(x, y)**），边界是什么形状，以及它的大小在见到数据之前是否已经固定。

label.zh: 几何型、判别式、非线性、非参数式

feedback.en: That describes k-NN-like models; naive Bayes is the opposite on every axis except one.
feedback.zh: 这描述的是类似 k-NN 的模型；朴素贝叶斯几乎每条轴都相反。

label.zh: 概率型、生成式、线性、参数式
概率型、判别式、线性、参数式

feedback.en: That is logistic regression. Naive Bayes models $P(\mathbf{x} \mid c)P(c)$, the joint, so it is generative.
feedback.zh: 这是逻辑回归。朴素贝叶斯建模的是 $P(\mathbf{x} \mid c)P(c)$，也就是联合分布，所以是生成式。

label.zh: 概率型、生成式、非线性、参数式

feedback.en: Multiplying probabilities looks non-linear, but in log space the score is a sum, so the boundary is linear. See the next page.
feedback.zh: 概率相乘看着像非线性，但取对数后得分是求和，边界是线性的。见下一页。

explain.en: Naive Bayes: probabilistic, generative, linear, parametric. The odd one out is *linear*, which the next page explains.
explain.zh: 朴素贝叶斯：概率型、生成式、线性、参数式。最容易想错的是*线性*，下一页解释。

title.en: The table, and the reasons behind it

text.en: † = lecture 23 does not place this one; the entry is the standard answer. A dash = not placed, because the model fits either side or the choice depends on how it is used.
text.zh: † = 第 23 讲没有给出这一项，填的是通行答案。短横线 = 没有分类：模型两边都说得通，或取决于怎么用。

text.en: Why each is where it is

items.en: **Naive Bayes is linear.** The score is $\log P(c) + \sum_i \log P(x_i \mid c)$: a sum of one term per feature, which is linear in the (indicator) features. The boundary is where two such sums are equal, a linear function of $\mathbf{x}$ again.
items.zh: **朴素贝叶斯是线性的。** 得分是 $\log P(c) + \sum_i \log P(x_i \mid c)$：每个特征一项求和，对（指示）特征是线性的。边界是两个这样的和相等的地方，仍是 $\mathbf{x}$ 的线性函数。

items.en: **Logistic regression is probabilistic and discriminative.** It models $P(y=1 \mid \mathbf{x};\theta) = \sigma(\theta^\top \mathbf{x})$ directly, and $P(y=0 \mid \mathbf{x}) = 1 - $ that. It never models how $\mathbf{x}$ is distributed.
items.zh: **逻辑回归是概率型、判别式。** 它直接建模 $P(y=1 \mid \mathbf{x};\theta) = \sigma(\theta^\top \mathbf{x})$，而 $P(y=0 \mid \mathbf{x})$ 就是 1 减它。它从不建模 $\mathbf{x}$ 本身怎么分布。

items.en: **k-NN is non-parametric.** There are no parameters to fit: the model *is* the stored training set, which grows with $N$. $k$ and the distance are hyperparameters you choose.
items.zh: **k-NN 是非参数式。** 没有要拟合的参数：模型*就是*存下来的训练集，随 $N$ 增大。$k$ 和距离函数是你选的超参数。

items.en: **Decision trees are non-parametric.** The number of splits and leaves is not fixed in advance; it grows with the data. **Max depth** is a hyperparameter that *caps* that growth, in the way $k$ tunes k-NN; it does not turn the tree into a fixed-size parametric model.
items.zh: **决策树是非参数式。** 分裂和叶子的个数不是事先定好的，而是随数据增长。**最大深度**是一个超参数，它*限制*增长，就像 $k$ 调节 k-NN；它并没有把树变成固定大小的参数模型。

items.en: **SVM is listed as non-parametric.** In its dual form the prediction is a sum over training points, $f(\mathbf{x}) = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i K(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{x}) + b$, and the support vectors typically grow with the data. A *linear* SVM is also linear: the axes are independent, so one model can be linear and non-parametric.
items.zh: **SVM 被列为非参数式。** 在对偶形式里，预测是对训练点求和：$f(\mathbf{x}) = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i K(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{x}) + b$，支持向量一般随数据增多。*线性* SVM 同时也是线性的：四条轴相互独立，一个模型可以既线性又非参数。

items.en: **The MLP is parametric** (the architecture fixes the number of weights) **and non-linear**, thanks to its activations; without them a stack of layers collapses to one linear map.
items.zh: **MLP 是参数式**（结构决定了权重个数）**且非线性**，靠的是激活函数；没有激活函数，多层会塌成一个线性映射。

title.en: The lecture warns the terms are ambiguous
title.zh: 讲义自己说这些词有歧义

body.en: Several definitions of parametric exist. In the exam, use lecture 23's: *parametric* = a fixed number of parameters whatever the amount of training data; *non-parametric* = the parameters grow with the data.
body.zh: “参数式”有好几种定义。考试里用第 23 讲的：*参数式* = 参数个数固定，与训练数据量无关；*非参数式* = 参数随数据增长。

summary.en: Why naive Bayes is linear: the log-odds
summary.zh: 为什么朴素贝叶斯是线性的：对数几率

text.en: Take binary features $x_i \in \{0, 1\}$ and two classes, with $p_{ic} = P(x_i = 1 \mid c)$. Predict class 1 when the log-odds are positive.
text.zh: 取二值特征 $x_i \in \{0, 1\}$ 和两个类，$p_{ic} = P(x_i = 1 \mid c)$。对数几率为正时预测类 1。

text.en: Each bracket is $a_i + w_i x_i$ with $w_i = \log\frac{p_{i1}(1 - p_{i0})}{p_{i0}(1 - p_{i1})}$, so the whole thing is $b + \sum_i w_i x_i$: a linear function of $\mathbf{x}$, the same form as logistic regression's $\theta^\top\mathbf{x}$. The two models fit the weights differently (counting versus gradient descent), which is why NB is generative and LR discriminative even though both are linear.
text.zh: 每个方括号都是 $a_i + w_i x_i$，其中 $w_i = \log\frac{p_{i1}(1 - p_{i0})}{p_{i0}(1 - p_{i1})}$，整体就是 $b + \sum_i w_i x_i$：$\mathbf{x}$ 的线性函数，和逻辑回归的 $\theta^\top\mathbf{x}$ 同一个形式。两者求权重的方式不同（数数 vs 梯度下降），所以 NB 是生成式、LR 是判别式，尽管都是线性的。

text.en: Not the slides' order, but the order the ideas build on each other. Seven units, 22 lessons.
text.zh: 不按讲义顺序，而按想法之间的依赖。七个单元，共 22 课。

rows.en: inductive bias; Bayes from the definition; MLE; entropy as expected surprise
rows.zh: 归纳偏置；从定义推贝叶斯；极大似然；熵 = 期望惊讶度

rows.en: curse of dimensionality; information gain = mutual information; smoothing as a prior
rows.zh: 维数灾难；信息增益 = 互信息；平滑即先验

rows.en: normal equation; cross-entropy and its gradient; margin, dual and kernels
rows.zh: 正规方程；交叉熵及其梯度；间隔、对偶与核
评估、偏差-方差、特征选择

rows.en: micro/macro by hand; the decomposition; PMI, MI, wrappers
rows.zh: 手算微平均/宏平均；偏差-方差分解；PMI、MI、wrapper

rows.en: update rule as SGD; the delta rule by the chain rule; AdaBoost weights derived
rows.zh: 更新规则即 SGD；用链式法则推 delta 规则；AdaBoost 权重推导

rows.en: clustering, semi-supervised and active, self-supervised, anomaly detection, fairness
rows.zh: 聚类、半监督与主动学习、自监督、异常检测、公平性

rows.en: k-means convergence; query strategies; contrastive loss; LOF; fairness criteria as conditional probabilities
rows.zh: k-means 收敛性；查询策略；对比损失；LOF；把公平性准则写成条件概率

rows.en: a method sheet; Section A, B and C practice

text.en: Every lesson has the same shape

items.en: **Purpose.** What the method is for, in a picture and a sentence.
items.zh: **目的。** 方法用来干什么，一张图加一句话。

items.en: **Mechanics.** The formulas, with what each term does.
items.zh: **机制。** 公式，以及每一项起什么作用。

items.en: **Derivations.** The results the slides only state, done line by line.
items.zh: **推导。** 讲义只给结论的地方，一行一行推出来。

items.en: **An exam-style calculation.** Small numbers, by hand, the way Section B asks.
items.zh: **一道考试风格的计算。** 小数字，手算，按 B 部分的问法。

items.en: **Deeper.** The topic the slides gesture at.
items.zh: **深入。** 讲义点到为止的话题。

items.en: **Traps.** The classic mistakes, as small questions.
items.zh: **陷阱。** 经典错误，做成小问题。

items.en: **Practice.** Section A and B style questions, sometimes a Section C one.
items.zh: **练习。** A、B 部分风格的题，有时有一道 C。

items.en: **What to remember.** The comparison you would put on a review sheet.
items.zh: **要记住的。** 你会写在复习小抄上的对比。

text.en: The last lesson collects every calculation family on one sheet and gives you a drill under exam conditions. Go through the lessons in order the first time; use the drill to find what to revisit.
text.zh: 最后一课把所有计算类型放在一张表上，再给你一套考试条件下的练习。第一遍按顺序走；用练习来找出该回头看的地方。
